articles.title: Treasury Secretary Invokes Bitcoin Creator Satoshi Nakamoto in Plea for Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Scott Bessent urged the Senate to immediately vote on the crypto market structure bill, accusing Democrats of delaying the legislation for political reasons.

articles.title: Fake Flare Network Staking Site Drained $8.5M in XRP: Seoul Police
articles.snippet: The ring copied Flare Network and its FXRP token, and planted Wikipedia entries, blog posts and YouTube videos to look legitimate.

articles.title: Markets Don’t Buy the US Ceasefire Against Iran Will Last
articles.snippet: The odds that a ceasefire lasts at least 14 consecutive days dropped by 10% today on Polymarket, and traders on Myriad believe peace talks won't happen until next month.
